name: uselayouts — premium micro-interactions
description: 64 MIT-licensed React micro-interactions copied from uselayouts. Apply creates a native editable storyboard; source files and dependency notes stay bundled for reference.

items.name: 3D Book
items.description: An interactive 3D book component with page flip animations.

items.name: Accessible Action
items.description: Interactive draggable card stack with 3D tilt, swipe-to-back gestures, click interactions, random rotation, and smooth spring animations.

items.name: AccordionOS
items.description: Interactive accordion showcase with animated content, image transitions, hover effects, keyboard navigation, autoplay, and responsive design.

items.name: Analog Stick
items.description: A metallic stick that tilts into the press. Hover a quadrant and the cap leans, the shadow shifts, and the matching arrow goes amber.

items.name: Animated Collection
items.description: A collection of items with smooth layout transitions and animations.

items.name: Bento Card
items.description: An interactive bento card with animated tabs and workspace preview.

items.name: Bottom Menu
items.description: A floating bottom navigation menu with smooth interactions.

items.name: Bucket
items.description: An interactive card component that simulates a bucket where chips are tossed and replaced with smooth physics-inspired animations.

items.name: Card Folder
items.description: This component creates an animated folder-style card with a background image, floating 3D object, hover effects, and customizable colors and text. You can easily change the images, colors, content, and animation settings from the card props.

items.name: Client Card
items.description: A client CRM card with payment and deadline rings, plus a morphing avatar stack.

items.name: Confidential Folder
items.description: A charcoal sleeve that pulls a letter out, flips it, and lands it in front of you.

items.name: Corner Video
items.description: A compact corner video player with smooth open/close morphing, autoplay, mute, enlarge, hover controls, and video scrubbing.

items.name: Coverflow Drag
items.description: A drag coverflow of portraits that scale, dim, and snap as you swipe.

items.name: Create Menu
items.description: A Start Creating pill that springs open into a list of create actions.

items.name: Curve Drawer
items.description: Side drawers whose inner edge starts as a bulge and morphs into a straight line as the panel settles.

items.name: Day Picker
items.description: A custom day picker component with smooth animations.

items.name: Delete Button
items.description: A confirmation button with smooth icon transitions.

items.name: Discover Button
items.description: An interactive button with expanding discovery state.

items.name: Discrete Tabs
items.description: A tab component with discrete sliding animations.

items.name: Drawer Buttons
items.description: Two buttons that open side drawers with a 3D fold. Payment comes from the right, cart from the left, and the fields stagger in.

items.name: Dynamic Grid Gallery
items.description: A 3×2 photo grid that grows the hovered row and column so one still takes the stage.

items.name: Dynamic Toolbar
items.description: A toolbar that adapts its size and layout based on content.

items.name: Editorial Deck
items.description: A stacked editorial story deck. Drag the front card and it springs back into the pile.

items.name: Empty Testimonial
items.description: An interactive empty state for testimonials with a playful folder animation.

items.name: Expandable Gallery
items.description: A photo gallery with smooth item expansion.

items.name: Feature Carousel
items.description: A smooth carousel for showcasing product features.

items.name: Filter Interaction
items.description: Interactive list items with hover and focus effects.

items.name: Fluid Expanding Grid
items.description: A responsive gallery grid that fluidly shifts and expands items using motion layout.

items.name: Focus Testimonials
items.description: Interactive testimonial section with hover-based focus effects, animated author tooltips, and expandable testimonials.

items.name: Folder Interaction
items.description: A folder management system with drag-and-drop-like feel.

items.name: Get In Touch
items.description: A glossy contact pill. Hover and the label lifts away so a portrait and YOU merge, then Let’s Talk! writes in.

items.name: Holographic Referral Card
items.description: A dark invite card that tilts in 3D with the pointer. A holographic glow follows. Touch stays still. Tab for a quiet glow.

items.name: Gooey Navbar
items.description: A pill nav that melts into its neighbor when you hover — liquid bridges, active dot.

items.name: Infinite Canvas
items.description: A free-panning product canvas that tiles forever — drag, scroll, and skim an endless grid of images and captions.

items.name: Inline Edit
items.description: An input that switches between read and edit modes.

items.name: Liquid Index
items.description: A feature list whose hover badge is a WebGL liquid gradient that tracks the row.

items.name: Magnified Bento
items.description: A bento card component with a draggable magnifying lens effect over scrolling chips.

items.name: Morphing Input
items.description: An input field that morphs between different states.

items.name: Multi Step Form
items.description: A dynamic, animated multi-step form with validation.

items.name: Overlapping Slider
items.description: A full-width landing row of portrait cards. They sit flat until you move — then the card on the left scales back.

items.name: Perspective Text Scroll
items.description: A polished example interaction built with React and Motion.

items.name: Photo Albums
items.description: Tilted album stacks that expand into a shared-element photo grid.

items.name: Paper Shred Button
items.description: Hover Delete and a page appears above it. Click and the page clips away while paper strips draw in below. After a few seconds it resets so you can shred again.

items.name: Polaroid Drag
items.description: Draggable Polaroid photo gallery with realistic tilt, stacking, smooth animations, and customizable captions, sizes, and decorations.

items.name: Polaroid Stack
items.description: Seven Polaroids sit in a pile. Hover and they fan into an arc from one corner.

items.name: Pop Tilt Cards
items.description: Interactive tilt card deck with smooth hover animations, 3D popping effects, images, links, and customizable card styling.

items.name: Pricing Card
items.description: A focused pricing card layout with clear hierarchy.

items.name: Prompt Box
items.description: A collapsed chat composer that expands into a textarea with a model menu and send control.

items.name: Rolling Card Stack
items.description: It’s a responsive, animated rolling card stack component built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. It supports desktop/mobile layouts, swipe and keyboard navigation, autoplay, pagination, and customizable card content

items.name: Save Button
items.description: A button with animated states for idle, loading, and success.

items.name: Scan Document
items.description: Click Scan and a page unfolds, flips, and a glowing bar reads it. Done holds, then it resets.

items.name: Scroll Split Cards
items.description: One photograph that splits into three panels as you scroll, then flips to copy.

items.name: Scroll Stack Deck
items.description: Scroll-linked project cards that pin in the viewport and stack, scale, and settle as you move down the page.

items.name: Set Timer
items.description: A dark timer pill that morphs into a minute wheel picker, then into a running timer with pause, cancel, and a rounded-rectangle progress border.

items.name: Shake Testimonial Card
items.description: An eye-catching testimonial card with playful animations.

items.name: Slide Subscribe
items.description: Pick a billing period, then slide to start a trial.

items.name: Smooth Dropdown
items.description: A dropdown menu with premium layout transitions.

items.name: Stack Scroll Reveal
items.description: Scroll-linked case-study cards that pin in the viewport and peel, scale, and fade as you move down the page.

items.name: Stacked List
items.description: An expandable list widget with a stacked layout and smooth morphing transitions.

items.name: Stacked Outline Text
items.description: Heavy outlined type you can drag. Speed leaves a stacked white-on-black trail that springs back when you stop.

items.name: Theme Toggle
items.description: A physical switch with a dotted grip. Click and the knob slides across a recessed track.

items.name: Tactile Button
items.description: A liquid-glass rocker that tilts into its well when you press it.

items.name: Vertical Tabs
items.description: A vertical tab interaction with smooth content switching.

items.name: Wheel Carousel
items.description: This component creates a smooth wheel-style carousel with photos and selectable items. It supports drag, scroll, keyboard controls, snapping, momentum, themes, image crossfades, and customizable layout and colors.
